details.publicNotes:
During the transformation from a drone to an overseer, a hemadae's stinger falls off, its abdomen develops an internal furnace, and four limbs turn into humanoid hand facsimiles. A new overseer's mind also expands, granting them a personality, unlike the single-minded drones. Though an overseer's personality bears some similarities to whoever the creature infected with ferrodermia was before becoming a hemadae, overseers almost universally have inflated egos and an obsession with control.

Hemadae overseers are responsible for directing drones and disseminating the queen's instructions to their subordinates. All the resources the hemadae drones collect are to fuel their superior's experiments and devices. The hemadae overseer designs and implements the queen's commands to expand and improve their arsenal. They build clockwork servants and soldiers, mechanical lifts, and doors throughout the hive. Their experiments with fire and acid often lead to disaster, leaving their bodies scarred. The experiments that succeed are turned into weapons or traps in their hive.

Hemadaes are metallic wasplike creatures with a few parts from humans or other mortal ancestries eerily hanging out from their body. A hemadae hive is a complex hybrid of a smith's forge and a massive wasp nest. Most hemadaes are drones, which do the grunt work inside and outside the hive. Particularly accomplished drones are transformed into overseers, egotistical and talented crafters who direct hordes of drones and control clockwork constructs in ceaseless toil. A single hemadae queen rules each hive, imposing her will through telepathic commands to the overseers. To communicate with each other, hemadae overseers and drones use a discordant language made from mandible clicks and the banging and scraping of metal.

Hemadaes reproduce by infecting other creatures with their genetic material. Their bite infects a horrific disease that slowly turns the victim's skin into an outer shell of metal, trapping them inside while the venom digests them alive. The primordial soup that remains then metamorphoses into a drone.

The Queen's Favor

In most hives, each hemadae overseer claims one area of expertise. One might manage feats of civil engineering by planning and leading tasks that improve efficiency within the hive, while another might dedicate all of their efforts to becoming the queen's mechanic. Additional common specializations include alchemy, defenses, and weapons. In larger hives, multiple overseers can take on each role but rarely work in tandem. Hemadae overseers engage in constant conflict and competition for the queen's favor, resulting in an internal arms race that often ends in disaster. Eventually, this internal strife causes factions to form, and groups of overseers escape a hive that's grown too large to form a new queen and dwelling.

The hemadae overseer makes a mandibles Strike against up to three different creatures. The attacks count toward the hemadae overseer's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they make all attacks.
